main.description: Hands the AppView credentials for a community hosted elsewhere, so it can administer a community it did not create. The password is stored encrypted at rest.

community.description: The community the credentials belong to.

identifier.description: The identifier used to authenticate with the community's PDS, such as its handle or DID.

password.description: The password or app password used to authenticate with the community's PDS.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks permission to register credentials for this community.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: CredentialsRejected
errors.description: The PDS refused the identifier and password.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.
